vintage: CEREMA noise 2022; INERIS air 2024; Géorisques industrial-risk perimeters, current publication

lenses.name: Industrial-risk perimeter
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside official industrial-risk prevention servitude perimeters (SUP industrial risk). These administrative prevention perimeters indicate regulated technological-risk areas, not accident probability or expected damage. Coverage follows the metropolitan Géorisques raster grid.

lenses.name: Major-road noise
lenses.description: Share of real land area modelled at Lden 55 dB(A) or higher around qualifying non-conceded roads in the 2022 strategic noise maps. Concessionaire motorways, urban-agglomeration noise, airports and industry are outside this layer; Paris and the three inner-ring departments are absent from the source. Type-A Lden polygons are aggregated approximately in 250 m bins and then assigned to map hexes; values are modelled exposure within the regulatory infrastructure scope, not measurements at a façade or total environmental noise.

lenses.name: Intense road noise
lenses.description: Share of real land area modelled at Lden 65 dB(A) or higher around qualifying non-conceded roads in the 2022 strategic noise maps. This stricter threshold highlights the most exposed corridors but remains limited to the source's infrastructure scope. Type-A Lden polygons are aggregated approximately in 250 m bins and then assigned to map hexes; values are modelled exposure within the regulatory infrastructure scope, not measurements at a façade or total environmental noise.

Type-A Lden polygons are aggregated approximately in 250 m bins and then assigned to map hexes; values are modelled exposure within the regulatory infrastructure scope, not measurements at a façade or total environmental noise.

lenses.name: Nitrogen dioxide
lenses.description: Annual mean background nitrogen-dioxide concentration in 2024. Higher values generally indicate more combustion-related urban and traffic-influenced background pollution. Values are commune-level annual mean background concentrations from measurements combined with CHIMERE modelling, distributed approximately over commune polygons. They do not characterize local peaks near traffic or industry; overseas territories are outside coverage. Arrondissement rows are averaged to their parent commune before distribution.

lenses.name: Fine particles PM2.5
lenses.description: Annual mean background PM2.5 concentration in 2024. Fine particles are a major long-term health-relevant air pollutant. Values are commune-level annual mean background concentrations from measurements combined with CHIMERE modelling, distributed approximately over commune polygons. They do not characterize local peaks near traffic or industry; overseas territories are outside coverage. Arrondissement rows are averaged to their parent commune before distribution.

lenses.name: Particles PM10
lenses.description: Annual mean background PM10 concentration in 2024. Values represent regional/urban background particulate pollution rather than short regulatory exceedance episodes. Values are commune-level annual mean background concentrations from measurements combined with CHIMERE modelling, distributed approximately over commune polygons. They do not characterize local peaks near traffic or industry; overseas territories are outside coverage. Arrondissement rows are averaged to their parent commune before distribution.
